text:
creative brief

Situation: Suicide and homicide due to mental health problems are the second and third leading causes of death for 10 to 24y/o. Gen Z is grappling with stress levels that surpass those of previous generations — around 15.9% of Gen Z adults were diagnosed with depression in 2020

Objective: Raise awareness of mental health issues among Gen Z population

Target Audience: Gen Z teenagers and adults (10 to 24y/o)

Tone: serious, reflective

insight & concept statement

Concept Statement: People with depression and other mental health issues can be really good at hiding how they actually feel. They put on an act when they are around others. By quoting things that people say when asked how they’re doing, the campaign will visually and interactively prompt individuals to confront themselves and address their mental health challenges. Face yourself.

Insight: Mental health patients sometimes tend to cover their problems up by acting like they’re fine in front of their friends and family, but in reality, they are struggling to face their mental health issues.

social media

Campaign #FaceYourself will encourage users to share their authentic feelings and emotions.



The campaign will invite therapists to give advice on social media platforms like Instagram and TikTok. Users can slide into their DMs, where they can ask the therapists questions or tell them what’s bothering them. This will prompt participants to share their authentic feelings, further encouraging them to go to actual therapy sessions, open up their feelings, and face themselves.
